config.alias: Deye DC Export First / Curtailment Capture
config.description: Live physical-headroom PV controller. Battery below the configured floor charges normally. Above the floor, a 5-minute solar-geometry model defines the seasonal clipping-risk window. Inside/before that window, the controller preserves P90-forecast headroom for otherwise-unexportable PV and allows only the minimum forecast-completion trickle needed to avoid finishing short. After the physical clipping window ends, battery headroom has no value and all PV remaining after house load is directed to the battery up to BMS/inverter limits; export is only residual. The existing 10-second current-gate feedback loop remains the actuator.

variables.target_inverter_w: {{ [[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max }}
variables.ac_error_w: {{ (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max) }}
variables.desired_charge_w: {{ [0, ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_battery_power') | float(0))] | max) + ((states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max))] | max }}
variables.desired_limit_a: {{ [[1, ((([0, ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_battery_power') | float(0))] | max) + ((states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([[states('sensor.deye_rated_power') | float(12000), ([0, (states('sensor.deye_inverter_power') | float(0)) - ([0, -(states('sensor.deye_grid_ct_power') | float(0))] | max)] | max) + (states('number.deye_max_sell_power') | float(10000))] | min, 0] | max))] | max) / (states('sensor.deye_battery_voltage') | float(52))) | round(0))] | max, ([states('sensor.deye_battery_charge_limit_current') | float(125), 250] | min)] | min }}

variables.scheduled_target_inverter_w: {{ [house_w | float(0), [target_inverter_w | float(0), [0, (states('sensor.deye_pv_power') | float(0)) - (forecast_recovery_charge_w | float(0))] | max] | min] | max }}

actions.alias: Physical headroom controller charge gate variables
